row.title: PROBE-FORMAT-1: malformed closing probes fail the PR and become a REDMAIN gate
row.body: Main went red twice on 2026-11-21 from a grep probe with one colon. writeback check now validates every ledger and write-back probe (format, path exists, regex compiles); record refuses a bad probe; the probe-format gate in doctrine/redmain.json lets ciwatch open a repair when main still turns red.
